title: GitHub Portfolio Search
one_liner: Semantic search engine for personal GitHub repositories using embeddings and TF-IDF.
what_it_is: A tool that indexes GitHub repositories, extracts README content, generates embeddings, and provides a searchable interface via CLI, REST API, and static web UI. It enables developers to find reusable code patterns and architectures across their own portfolio using natural language queries.
how_its_built: Built with Python for the indexing pipeline (using sentence-transformers and SQLite-vec) and FastAPI for the backend. The frontend is a static HTML/JS application served from S3/CloudFront. Indexing is automated via GitHub Actions. Authentication uses Google OAuth via AWS Lambda. Data is stored in SQLite and JSON files.
how_to_apply: Clone the repo, install dependencies, configure a GitHub token, index your repos, and serve the web UI or use the CLI. Deployable to AWS S3/CloudFront for public access. Integrates with AI agents via MCP server.
quickstart:
git clone https://github.com/davidbmar/github-portfolio-search.git
cd github-portfolio-search
python3 -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate
pip install -e ".[dev]"
cp .env.example .env
ghps index <your_github_username>
ghps export
cd web && python3 -m http.server 8000
features: Semantic search using embeddings and TF-IDF across READMEs and code
Auto-clustering of repositories into capability categories
Static web UI with faceted filtering and autocomplete
CLI tool for indexing, searching, and exporting data
MCP server integration for AI agent access
Automated weekly reindexing via GitHub Actions
